A little about me

Creative thinking, thoughtful details.

I enjoy turning ideas into designs that are easy to understand, visually engaging, and consistent with the purpose behind them.

My approach

I explore typography, colour, spacing, and composition to create designs that feel intentional. Whether it’s a social post, a celebration invitation, or a book layout, I aim to make every element work together.

What I design

My focus is on social media content, digital invitations and greeting cards, e-book layouts, and book covers and interiors. I’m interested in working with small businesses, authors, and individuals.
